summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Homeland Security to inspect newly acquired foreign cranes that connect to the internet and are deemed high-risk before they are used at U.S. ports, and prohibits the operation of new foreign cranes and foreign software on existing cranes after certain dates.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates inspections of foreign cranes by the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and requires the Secretary of Homeland Security to conduct assessments and report to Congress. These activities would necessitate government resources and thus increase government spending, though likely not a significant amount in the grand scheme of the federal budget.
